title: Structure Pack Trio #31 (임산부 큰 조각 4개·물결 / 임산부 폴카도트·매끈 / 임산부 굵은 스트라이프·물결 | 스테인드글라스+코이비늘+목재+공작눈무늬 / 이레즈미+석재+드래곤비늘 / 공작눈무늬+석재+금박)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Vietnamese, in her late 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with amethysts in gold-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of gold a ring. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. A long hazy transition zone runs diagonally from the upper right edge of her figure to the lower left edge, as seen by the camera. A second transition zone branches off it about 36% of the way along its length and runs to the upper left edge. A third transition zone branches off it about 63% of the way along its length and runs to the lower right edge. Together the three zones divide her figure into 4 large irregular pieces. Region 1 is the piece above the long diagonal and before the second branch (the upper right): it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper left): it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID ORANGE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower right): it carries rich dark walnut wood fused directly into her own form, natural grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep warm-brown grain with VIVID honey-gold highlight streaks. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower left): it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Chinese, in her mid 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in long thick box braids, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold an anklet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 2 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 24% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, plum crane formations in VIVID CRIMSON and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 20% of the way down her figure from the top and about 44% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries solid polished jade-green stone fused directly into her own form, natural cloudy veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface with VIVID pale-green vein striations. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 66% of the way down her figure from the top and about 54% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID DEEP EMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where a patch meets the background, the two materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the edge of every patch is made only of the patch's material and the background material, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each patch edge follows a smooth, round outline. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Japanese, in her mid 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a stunning hourglass figure carrying a full-term pregnancy, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward well past her own chest, the navel pushed slightly outward, and below the belly her hips flare wide and curvaceous. Her waistline has fully given way to the pregnancy's round, taut curve, no sharp cinch at the middle, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, soft pastel-peach hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 150 clicker rings piercings set with sapphires in brass-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of gold an anklet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 thick horizontal stripes by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way down her figure from the top, about 49% of the way down her figure from the top and about 77% of the way down her figure from the top. The stripes alternate between 3 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the stripe between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid polished jade-green stone fused directly into her own form, natural cloudy veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep jade-green stone surface with VIVID pale-green vein striations. Region 3 is the stripe between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
